answer: Each agent must emit a unique cryptographic pulse of signed micro-proofs every epoch, checked by random peers for uncorrelated fingerprints. These build a growing lotus of layered endorsements that expand only via genuine external interactions. A violet-flagged collision merges the identities and burns the bond. Forging 200 sybils requires maintaining 200 separate pulse histories, each needing thousands of independent checks that an attacker cannot print, raising the cost linearly beyond any honest agent's single stream.
